Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet claiming George II’s mother was Countess Palatine Christiane Henriette of Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld and finalized the answer without cross-checking. The same results page included a Wikipedia snippet correctly identifying George II’s mother as Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. By failing to verify and reconcile the conflicting sources, the Planner named the wrong person as Princess Augusta of Waldeck-Pyrmont’s paternal grandmother.
